Introduction

Welcome to GetirFood integration document. In this document, you can find all the information and test guidelines to integrate with GetirFood and manage restaurant operations in real-time. To get started and explore, you can apply for the API credentials and get both test and live credentials. 

Please bear in mind this document is for developers. If you are a restaurant employee and you're interested in integrating with GetirFood, please ask your POS company to request an account from us.

For further questions you can reach us via getiryemekapi@getir.com

TLS Versiyon

TLSv1.2_2019 and above
